reserves.name: ETFs linked to Brazilian Treasury securities

sources.label: Fact Finance BRLV proof-of-reserves report - May 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The May 31, 2026 Fact Finance report records R$373,246,013.59 of Brazilian Treasury bonds and R$34,130.28 of Treasury-linked ETFs, reported as 99.99% and 0.01% of reserves. Cash and equivalents were only R$593.72 and rounded to 0.00%, so they are not represented as a positive slice.
